messages:
dlee: heads-up, onboarding openmistral-mini-7b from HF. conversion step failed when loading tokenizer.json — loader complains about referenced merges.txt missing.

rpatel: can you paste the exact error and which files were pulled from HF?

dlee: error: 
```
ValueError: tokenizer.json references BPE merges file 'merges.txt' but 'merges.txt' not found in artifact path /redwood/models/openmistral-mini-7b/tokenizer.json
```
Pulled files: tokenizer.json, vocab.json, tokenizer_config.json from https://huggingface.co/openmistral/openmistral-mini-7b

cwu: classic fast/slow mismatch. tokenizer.json (fast) can embed references to merges/vocab combos that don't always accompany the .json. If merges is missing, our fast loader bails.

dlee: tokenizer_config.json has "use_fast": true and special tokens map to <s>, </s>, <pad>. When running quantized LLM eval (int8) the chat system messages got tokenized differently and QA accuracy dropped ~2.8% vs baseline.

rpatel: quick mitigation ideas: 1) detect missing referenced files in converter and force a slow-tokenizer fallback (set use_fast=false or use HF slow tokenizers); 2) attempt to reconstruct merges from vocab.json heuristics (risky); 3) fail fast with clear error telling user which files to upload.

cwu: prefer (1) + clear telemetry: log that we fell back to slow tokenizer so we can correlate with quality regressions. Also add a small unit test simulating tokenizer.json that references nonexistent merges.

dlee: created a short prompt set that uses system tokens and multi-turn chat templates to surface this. I'll re-run quant-eval/2025-01/openmistral-mini-7b once converter patch lands.

infra-bot: conversion-runner v0.27.0 scheduled to run on redwood-conversions in 8 minutes.

rpatel: I'll open a PR with the guard + fallback and add a warning in conversion output: "tokenizer.json references external files missing; using slow-tokenizer fallback". PR #4776. cc @cwu @dlee

cwu: one more note: ensure we normalize names for special tokens (cls/sep vs <s>/</s>) — our chat template code expects <s> markers. Add a converter normalization pass.

dlee: ack. adding "tokenizer artifact completeness" to onboarding checklist and will attach failing bundle to the PR. Thanks everyone.
